page_title: JUV 3-0 COM | Juventus v Como 19/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Matteo Marcenaro has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' A tremendous drive by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Pepe Reina makes a brilliant save.
90+5' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

90+5' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Alberto Cerri (Como) is caught offside!
90+1' 3 - 0 Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) struck from medium range. He smashed the ball inside the left post. What a hit! Pure magic.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is flagged for offside.
88' A yellow card is awarded to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
87' The game is interrupted as Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is flagged offside.
86' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
85' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Di Gregorio, who smothers the ball.
84' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
83' The foul by Gabriel Strefezza (Como) was seen by Matteo Marcenaro who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' Matteo Marcenaro blows the whistle, Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is penalised for a foul.
79' It's time for a substitution. Douglas Luiz (Juventus) comes on in place of Manuel Locatelli.
78' Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
76' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Matteo Marcenaro's book.
74' Federico Barba (Como) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
72' Simone Verdi (Como) gets booked for the first time in this match.
70' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
70' Simone Verdi (Como) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alberto Cerri, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
69' Juan Cabal (Juventus) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
69' Corner kick. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is ready to send the ball into the box.
69' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Khephren Thuram cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Here is a change. Patrick Cutrone is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Cerri (Como).
63' Oliver Abildgaard has picked up an injury and is replaced by Simone Verdi (Como).
60' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
58' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marcenaro after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
56' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Lucas Da Cunha and he is replaced by Oliver Abildgaard (Como).
56' Substitution. Andrea Belotti makes way for Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
53' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is in a good position inside the six-yard box to head a rebound home, but he is not precise enough and the ball flies away off the right post.

53' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Pepe Reina anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
51' The resulting free kick from Gabriel Strefezza (Como) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
49' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Juventus due to an offside in the build-up play.
49' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Matteo Marcenaro makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
46' The game is over for Timothy Weah. Nicolo Savona (Juventus) comes on for the second half.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

45+1' 2 - 0 Kenan Yildiz passes the ball into the penalty area. Timothy Weah (Juventus) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:0!
45+1' Alberto Moreno (Como) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Andrea Belotti (Como) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
43' Patrick Cutrone (Como) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
43' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
42' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Pepe Reina to dive and make a save.
41' Patrick Cutrone (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Juventus have a free kick from a promising distance.
40' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

38' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Matteo Marcenaro blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

37' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marcenaro with no other option than to blow for a foul.
36' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
35' Timothy Weah (Juventus) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
35' Juventus get a corner.

34' What a save from Pepe Reina! Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
34' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
31' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
30' A pass from Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) is intercepted by Pepe Reina and the move breaks down.
28' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle after Gabriel Strefezza (Como) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
26' A cooling break is underway.
23' 1 - 0 Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) finds the back of the net with a strike from the edge of the penalty box, with the ball finding the bottom right corner of the goal.
22' Problems for Cesc Fabregas as Daniele Baselli is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Yannik Engelhardt (Como) replaces him.

20' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
19' Daniele Baselli (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' Daniele Baselli (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' Andrea Belotti (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Como will take a throw-in.
15' Federico Gatti (Juventus) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
14' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pepe Reina intercepts the ball.
14' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
13' Marco Sala (Como) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
9' A yellow card for a tackle by Marco Sala (Como). Matteo Marcenaro doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
8' An attempted cross from Alberto Moreno (Como) is cleared.
6' Federico Barba (Como) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Timothy Weah (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' Timothy Weah (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Matteo Marcenaro.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
